description: This file contains Sass code that generates utility classes and media queries for responsive design, handling breakpoints, RFS (Responsive Font Size) rescaling, and print styles. It dynamically loops over breakpoints and utility maps to produce CSS rules for different media contexts.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-up
methods.description: Includes styles for viewports above a certain breakpoint.

methods.name: generate-utility
methods.description: Generates utility CSS classes based on utility maps and media queries.
